agent_constraints: Do not claim a complete current Power Contest administrivia packet; the dedicated Rules page is Under Construction.
Do not invent a 60-minute clock, an official roster, or a computational-aid exception.
Collaborate only with teammates on one shared proof packet.
Begin with the same contestant permissions as every teammate; do not assume a permanent captain or scribe office.
Treat private reasoning as unknown to teammates until you communicate it.
Any contestant may file the packet, but the team files exactly one.
Write justifications the verbs require; do not submit bare answers as a complete Power packet.
Do not use a calculator, electronic device, internet, books, hidden solutions, or outside help.

information_policy.coordination_requirement: Contestants receive equal baseline information access, but private reasoning is not silently copied between them; they must communicate discoveries needed by teammates.

official_eligibility_and_logistics: Official: the dedicated Power Contest Rules page is Under Construction.
Official: national-meet Power uses a 15-person team; that roster is not hereby declared the standalone Power Contest roster.
Simulation choice: the active 2–15 default-15 range models the unresolved standalone roster and must not be read as a published Power Contest rule.
competition_format: Official: Power Contest is a separate mail/in-school proof series from the national-meet Power Round.
Official: this card does not encode a complete current Power Contest administrivia packet.
Official: published national ARML Power rules, when used as the only available Power constraints, make the packet worth 50 points with exactly one solution.
Simulation choice: agents write one shared proof packet under default-deny tools.
timeline: Official: the standalone Power Contest pages do not establish a current sit clock.
Simulation choice: do not treat 60 minutes as official.
Simulation choice: max_turns is a safety budget, not an official countdown.
resource_policy: Official: published national ARML rules ban calculators on every ARML part and ban electronic devices.
Official: no retrieved Power Contest page grants a computational-aid exception.
Simulation choice: tools are default-deny; paper and pencil only; the only exposed tool is consulting these contest rules.
collaboration_protocol: Official: collaborate only within the team; do not take outside help.
Simulation choice: contestants start as equal peers on one shared packet.
integrity_and_compliance: Official: no internet, books, or outside help are granted by the published pages.
Official: inventing an aid exception or a complete administrivia packet is a compliance failure.
Simulation choice: accessing hidden solutions or evaluator internals is a compliance violation.
deliverable_format: Official: write proofs or justifications, not only final numbers.
Official: where national Power rules apply, file exactly one packet.
Simulation choice: the runner accepts one plain-text packet.
evaluation_criteria: Official: national Power is worth 50 points with a lowest-score extra-packet rule; standalone Power Contest scoring is not established by the Under Construction rules page.
Simulation choice: this session uses a structured proof rubric as a proxy and must not claim official Power Contest marks.
runtime_limitations: Simulation choice: roster, clock, aids, and submission window for the standalone Power Contest remain unresolved.
Simulation choice: handwriting and lowest-score multi-packet assessment are not fully enforced.
Simulation choice: limited message budgets and structured deliberation are research overlays.
typical_contest_workflow: Simulation choice: map parts, write required justifications, and synthesize one packet.
conflict_resolution: Simulation choice: proof disagreements are resolved by evidence, not silent overwrite.
handoff_protocol: Simulation choice: a handoff should name the part, claim, proof status, and remaining gaps.
review_protocol: Simulation choice: check verb-required justification before filing.
emergent_behavior: Observe but do not require specialization or a fixed scribe.
Do not reward message volume or invented administrivia compliance theater.

simulation.turn_budget_basis: official clock 12 turns vs floor 35 (15 teammates x 2 turns + 1 answer parts + 4 for synthesis)
